name: zcode-plugins
description: Community plugins for the ZCode CLI runtime (unofficial).

plugins.name: zcode-model-config
plugins.description: Open a local web UI (React + StyleX) to edit ZCode CLI model / provider config: providers, per-model fields including multimodal toggles, main/lite model roles, with a models.dev (Vercel AI SDK) catalog for one-click import. Reads and writes the user config (~/.zcode/cli/config.json) and project config (zcode.json / .zcode/config.json). Unofficial.

description_i18n.en: Open a local web UI (React + StyleX) to edit ZCode CLI model / provider config: providers, per-model fields including multimodal toggles, main/lite model roles, with a models.dev (Vercel AI SDK) catalog for one-click import. Reads and writes the user config (~/.zcode/cli/config.json) and project config (zcode.json / .zcode/config.json). Unofficial.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 打开本地 Web 页面（React + StyleX）编辑 ZCode CLI 的模型 / Provider 配置：Provider 管理、逐模型字段（含多模态开关）、main/lite 模型角色，内置 models.dev（Vercel AI SDK）目录一键导入。读写用户级配置（~/.zcode/cli/config.json）与项目级配置（zcode.json / .zcode/config.json）。非官方实现。
